blocks.text: MANILA, PHILIPPINES — Mayor Francis Zamora recently welcomed delegations from Australia and Cebu City for an exchange on local governance, programs, and best practices. The delegation from the Australian Political Exchange Council was headed by Sen. Josh Anthony Dolega of Tasmania, a member of the Australian parliament, and the one from Cebu City was headed Mayor Nestor Archival, who was joined by members of the Cebu City Council. During the program, Dolega praised Zamora’s staunch commitment to making education a priority in local governance.
